header:
How the rich avoid
selling their stock

cover.title: Why Billionaires Borrow Instead of Selling
cover.label: LOAN

lines.text: Why do billionaires borrow money when they're already rich? Because selling costs them.
lines.say: Why do billionaires borrow money when they're already rich? Because selling costs them.

lines.text: Sell stock that went up, and you owe capital gains tax on the profit.
lines.say: Sell stock that went up, and you owe capital gains tax on the profit.

lines.text: So instead, they borrow against their stock. A loan isn't income, so there's no tax on it.
lines.say: So instead, they borrow against their stock. A loan isn't income, so there's no tax on it.

lines.text: The stock keeps growing, and they pay interest on the loan instead.
lines.say: The stock keeps growing, and they pay interest on the loan instead.

lines.text: People call it buy, borrow, die. Buy assets. Borrow against them. And hold them until death.
lines.say: People call it buy, borrow, die. Buy assets. Borrow against them. And hold them until death.

lines.text: Under current U.S. law, heirs usually get a stepped-up basis, so the gains during the owner's life may never be taxed.
lines.say: Under current U.S. law, heirs usually get a stepped-up basis, so the gains during the owner's life may never be taxed.

lines.text: It only works with a lot of assets, and borrowing always carries risk if prices fall.
lines.say: It only works with a lot of assets, and borrowing always carries risk if prices fall.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.
lines.say: That's the money. Follow for more.
